describe.description: The image shows a single quadrupedal animal in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background, standing on all four limbs with its back arched. The animal is mostly covered in overlapping dark brown to gray scales, but has several large, irregular areas of pale pink, smooth, fleshy skin exposed on its dorsal mid-back, mid-flank, and rear hip. It has a small elongated head with a pointed snout facing right, stout limbs ending in large curved claws, and a long tapering scaly tail extending horizontally behind it to the right and resting on the ground.

describe.description: A stocky quadrupedal mammal shown in right-side profile walking to the right. Its arched body is mostly covered in overlapping dark gray-brown rounded scales on the back, sides, top of the head, outer legs, and long tapering tail. Large irregular patches of smooth pale pink bare skin are exposed on the upper mid-back, mid-flank, and rear flank where scales are missing. The head is small with a narrow pointed snout, dark nose, small dark eye, and small rounded ear. The legs are short and stout with pale skin below and broad feet bearing long curved dark claws with specks of dirt around the toes. The scaled tail extends back along the ground to the right behind the legs.
